entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Akhilesh Kumar,G.A.,Pramil Kumar
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared on behalf of informant.

3. The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant in case crime No. 221 of 2020,
under Section 363, 366, 376, 120-B IPC and 3/4 Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act,
2012, P.S. Shahganj, District Jaunpur, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

entities.text:
Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act,
2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The first bail application of applicant was dismissed for want of prosecution.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

Alleged incident has been shown of 13.09.2020, but first information Vishal Sahni vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184724541/
1 report was registered on 24.09.2020 alleging that applicant and co-accused persons have enticed away minor daughter of informant.

entities.text: Vishal Sahni vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was pointed out that in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. victim has alleged that she was enticed away by applicant and he took her to Jaipur but she did not make any complaint.
She has further alleged that Jaipur, applicant kept her at the house of his sister and committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel submitted that the age of victim was stated to be 16 years but in fact she is a major girl and her ossification test has not been conducted.
Victim has not sustained any injury.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 12.10.2020 and thus, he has already undergone detention of about four and a half years and during trial only one witness (informant) has been examined so far and the victim is not being produced for evidence before trial Court.
Referring to these facts of the matter, it was submitted that trial of the applicant would take sufficient long time.
Applicant has no criminal history.
It was submitted that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the victim is a minor girl aged about 16 years and she has made allegations of rape against the applicant.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.

7. The bail application is allowed.
8. Let the applicant, Vishal Sahni involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii.
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

9. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
10. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 6.2.2025 RKM  Vishal Sahni vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184724541/
